text.en: The short-circuit current is whatever current flows through any load resistor you happen to connect, not specifically the current when the terminals are joined by a plain wire.
text.et: Lühisvool on see vool, mis läbib suvalist koormustakistit, mille sa ühendad, mitte konkreetselt vool, mis tekib, kui klemmid on ühendatud lihtsa traadiga.
